calculate:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Separates array elements by index parity, sorts each parity group, then checks whether the alternating merge of the sorted groups is non-decreasing and returns the first violating index or 'OK'." calculate]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> arr </REF>: array "Input array of values to be partitioned and checked."
        <REF> size </REF>: integer "Number of elements in arr to process, using indices 0 through size-1."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: string "Returns the earlier index of the first out-of-order adjacent pair as a string, or the string 'OK' if the merged sequence is non-decreasing."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Create even_arr as a zero-filled list of length floor(size / 2) and odd_arr as a zero-filled list of length size - len(even_arr). RESULT even_arr, odd_arr]
            [COMMAND Set eveni to 0 and oddi to 0. RESULT eveni, oddi]
            [COMMAND For each i from 0 to size - 1, if (i + 1) % 2 == 0 then copy arr[i] into even_arr[eveni] and increment eveni; otherwise copy arr[i] into odd_arr[oddi] and increment oddi. RESULT even_arr, odd_arr, eveni, oddi]
            [COMMAND Sort even_arr and odd_arr in ascending order. RESULT even_arr, odd_arr]
            [COMMAND Reset eveni to 0, oddi to 0, and set last to -1. RESULT eveni, oddi, last]
            [COMMAND In the second loop over i from 0 to size - 1, if i == 0, set last to odd_arr[oddi], increment oddi, and continue to the next iteration. RESULT last, oddi]
            [COMMAND In the second loop, for each remaining i greater than 0, branch on parity: if i is odd, then if even_arr[eveni] is less than last, return str(i - 1); otherwise set last to even_arr[eveni] and increment eveni. If i is even, then if odd_arr[oddi] is less than last, return str(i - 1); otherwise set last to odd_arr[oddi] and increment oddi. RESULT last, eveni, oddi, return_value]
            [COMMAND After the second loop completes without returning, return the string 'OK'. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
